705|                return cls(2026, 7, 6)
706|

709|        result = convert_duration(d, "day", jurisdiction="AU")

712|        assert 5 <= result["value"] <= 9

760|class TestRoundTrip:
761|    def test_days_roundtrip_via_weeks(self):
762|        text = "14 days"
763|        d = parse_duration(text)
764|        as_weeks = convert_duration(d, "week")
765|        back = convert_duration(as_weeks, "day")
766|        assert back["ok"] is True
767|        assert abs(back["value"] - 14.0) < 1.0  # allow floating-point slop

769|    def test_months_roundtrip_via_days(self):
770|        d = parse_duration("3 months")
771|        as_days = convert_duration(d, "day")
772|        back = convert_duration(as_days, "month")
773|        assert back["ok"] is True
774|        assert abs(back["value"] - 3.0) < 0.1
775|
776|    def test_business_days_approximate_roundtrip(self):
777|        # Business-day ↔ calendar-day roundtrip is approximate
778|        d = parse_duration("10 business days")
779|        as_cal = convert_duration(d, "day")
780|        back = convert_duration(as_cal, "business_day")
781|        assert back["ok"] is True
782|        # Roundtrip should be within 20% due to calendar approximation
783|        assert abs(back["value"] - 10.0) / 10.0 < 0.20
784|
785|    def test_year_to_months_to_year(self):

788|        back = convert_duration(as_months, "year")
789|        assert back["ok"] is True
790|        assert abs(back["value"] - 2.0) < 0.1
791|
792|    def test_parse_then_convert_written_out(self):
793|        # "thirty days" → parse → convert to months → back to days
794|        d = parse_duration("thirty days")
795|        assert d["ok"] is True
796|        as_months = convert_duration(d, "month")
797|        assert as_months["ok"] is True
798|        back = convert_duration(as_months, "day")
799|        assert back["ok"] is True

835|=== /tmp/hello_agent/tests/symbolic/test_formula.py ===
836|"""Tests for src.pipeline.symbolic.formula.
837|
838|Owner doc: docs/design/bulk-review-neuro-symbolic-reasoning-plan.md §14.2.
839|
840|Coverage targets:
841|  - Happy path: arithmetic, max/min, identifiers from env
842|  - Missing identifiers: {ok: False}
843|  - Malicious input rejection: __import__, os.system, etc.
844|  - Security: no arbitrary builtins, no attribute access, no subscripts
845|  - Edge cases: division by zero, empty expression, non-string input
846|"""
847|
848|from __future__ import annotations
849|
850|from decimal import Decimal
851|
852|from src.pipeline.symbolic.formula import evaluate_money_formula
853|
854|# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
855|# Helpers
856|# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
857|
858|
859|def _ok(expr: str, env: dict, expected: str) -> None:
860|    result = evaluate_money_formula(expr, env)
861|    assert result["ok"] is True, f"Expected ok for {expr!r}, got {result}"
862|    assert Decimal(result["value"]) == Decimal(expected), (
863|        f"value mismatch for {expr!r}: expected {expected}, got {result['value']}"
864|    )
865|
866|
867|def _fail(expr: str, env: dict | None = None) -> dict:
868|    result = evaluate_money_formula(expr, env or {})
869|    assert result["ok"] is False, f"Expected failure for {expr!r}, got {result}"
870|    return result
871|
872|
873|# ===========================================================================
874|# Happy path — arithmetic
875|# ===========================================================================
876|
877|
878|class TestArithmetic:
879|    def test_multiply_scalar(self):
880|        _ok("12 * monthly_fees", {"monthly_fees": Decimal("50000")}, "600000")
881|
882|    def test_add_two_values(self):
883|        _ok("cap + buffer", {"cap": Decimal("1000000"), "buffer": Decimal("100000")}, "1100000")
884|
885|    def test_subtract(self):
886|        _ok("total - deductible", {"total": Decimal("500000"), "deductible": Decimal("50000")}, "450000")
887|
888|    def test_divide(self):
889|        _ok("annual / 12", {"annual": Decimal("1200000")}, "100000")
890|
891|    def test_integer_literals(self):
892|        _ok("3 * 4", {}, "12")
893|
894|    def test_decimal_literal(self):
895|        _ok("1.5 * base", {"base": Decimal("1000000")}, "1500000")

897|    def test_compound_expression(self):

899|            "12 * monthly_fees + buffer",

1105|"""Tests for src.pipeline.symbolic.money.
1106|
1107|Owner doc: docs/design/bulk-review-neuro-symbolic-reasoning-plan.md §14.2.
1108|
1109|Coverage targets:
1110|  - parse_money: numeric + written-out amounts, all supported currencies/symbols
1111|  - Magnitudes: K, M, B, million, thousand, billion in digit and word forms
1112|  - Cross-currency comparison (fails closed — callers supply rates)
1113|  - Edge cases: Unicode, OCR artefacts, exotic currencies, malformed input
1114|  - Round-trip: parse_money → format_money → parse_money
1115|"""
1116|
1117|from __future__ import annotations
1118|
1119|from decimal import Decimal
1120|
1121|import pytest
1122|
1123|from src.pipeline.symbolic.money import format_money, parse_money
1124|
1125|# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
1126|# Helpers
1127|# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
1128|
1129|
1130|def _ok(text: str, amount: str, currency: str, mag: int = 1) -> None:
1131|    result = parse_money(text)
1132|    assert result["ok"] is True, f"Expected ok for {text!r}, got {result}"
1133|    assert Decimal(result["amount"]) == Decimal(amount), (
1134|        f"amount mismatch for {text!r}: expected {amount}, got {result['amount']}"
1135|    )
1136|    assert result["currency"] == currency, (
1137|        f"currency mismatch for {text!r}: expected {currency}, got {result['currency']}"
1138|    )
1139|    assert result["magnitude_factor"] == mag, (
1140|        f"magnitude_factor mismatch for {text!r}: expected {mag}, got {result['magnitude_factor']}"
1141|    )
1142|
1143|
1144|def _fail(text: str) -> None:
1145|    result = parse_money(text)
1146|    assert result["ok"] is False, f"Expected failure for {text!r}, got {result}"
1147|
1148|
1149|# ===========================================================================
1150|# parse_money — USD / dollar sign
1151|# ===========================================================================
1152|
1153|
1154|class TestParseMoneyUSD:
1155|    def test_dollar_sign_integer(self):
1156|        _ok("$500,000", "500000", "USD")
1157|
1158|    def test_dollar_sign_decimal(self):
1159|        _ok("$1.5", "1.5", "USD")
1160|
1161|    def test_us_dollar_prefix(self):
1162|        _ok("US$1,000,000", "1000000", "USD")
1163|
1164|    def test_usd_code_prefix(self):
1165|        _ok("USD 250,000", "250000", "USD")
1166|
1167|    def test_amount_before_usd(self):
1168|        _ok("250,000 USD", "250000", "USD")
1169|
1170|    def test_dollar_millions_suffix(self):
1171|        _ok("$1.5M", "1500000", "USD", 1_000_000)
1172|
1173|    def test_dollar_thousand_suffix(self):
1174|        _ok("$500K", "500000", "USD", 1_000)
1175|
1176|    def test_dollar_billion_suffix(self):
1177|        _ok("$2B", "2000000000", "USD", 1_000_000_000)
1178|
1179|    def test_dollar_written_million(self):
1180|        _ok("$12 million", "12000000", "USD", 1_000_000)
1181|
1182|    def test_usd_written_million(self):
1183|        _ok("USD 1.5 million", "1500000", "USD", 1_000_000)

1314|# ===========================================================================
1315|# parse_money — edge cases and OCR artefacts
1316|# ===========================================================================
1317|
1318|
1319|class TestParseMoneyEdgeCases:
1320|    def test_embedded_in_sentence(self):
1321|        result = parse_money("The liability cap is $1,500,000 USD per event.")
1322|        assert result["ok"] is True
1323|        assert Decimal(result["amount"]) == Decimal("1500000")
1324|
1325|    def test_no_thousands_separator(self):
1326|        _ok("USD 1500000", "1500000", "USD")
1327|
1328|    def test_underscore_thousands(self):
1329|        result = parse_money("USD 1_000_000")
1330|        # Underscores treated as thousands separators
1331|        assert result["ok"] is True
1332|        assert Decimal(result["amount"]) == Decimal("1000000")
1333|
1334|    def test_unicode_non_breaking_space(self):
1335|        # Non-breaking space between amount and code
1336|        result = parse_money("USD\u00a0500,000")
1337|        assert result["ok"] is True
1338|
1339|    def test_unicode_minus_normalised(self):
1340|        # Unicode minus in negative-looking context — should still find the positive amount
1341|        result = parse_money("USD 1,000,000 (less USD 50,000)")
1342|        assert result["ok"] is True
1343|        assert Decimal(result["amount"]) == Decimal("1000000")
1344|
1345|    def test_no_money_expression_fails(self):
1346|        _fail("This agreement has no monetary values.")
1347|
1348|    def test_empty_string_fails(self):
1349|        _fail("")
1350|
1351|    def test_whitespace_only_fails(self):
1352|        _fail("   ")
1353|
1354|    def test_non_string_input_fails(self):
1355|        result = parse_money(12345)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
1356|        assert result["ok"] is False
1357|
1358|    def test_none_input_fails(self):
1359|        result = parse_money(None)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
1360|        assert result["ok"] is False
1361|
1362|    def test_amount_with_decimal(self):
1363|        _ok("USD 1,234,567.89", "1234567.89", "USD")
1364|
1365|    def test_ocr_double_space(self):
1366|        result = parse_money("USD  500,000")
1367|        assert result["ok"] is True
1368|        assert Decimal(result["amount"]) == Decimal("500000")
1369|
1370|    def test_unicode_right_quote(self):
1371|        # Right single quote sometimes appears in OCR for apostrophe
1372|        result = parse_money("USD\u2019500,000")
1373|        # Should either parse (treating quote as separator) or fail gracefully
1374|        assert "ok" in result
1375|
1376|    def test_large_amount(self):
1377|        _ok("$1,000,000,000", "1000000000", "USD")
1378|
1379|    def test_zero_amount(self):
1380|        result = parse_money("USD 0")
1381|        assert result["ok"] is True
1382|        assert Decimal(result["amount"]) == Decimal("0")
1383|
1384|    def test_amount_only_no_currency_fails(self):
1385|        # A bare number with no currency context should fail
1386|        _fail("500000")
1387|
1388|    def test_first_match_wins(self):
1389|        # Multiple amounts in text — first match is returned
1390|        result = parse_money("Between USD 100,000 and USD 500,000.")
1391|        assert result["ok"] is True
1392|        assert Decimal(result["amount"]) == Decimal("100000")
1393|
1394|
1395|# ===========================================================================
1396|# parse_money — cross-currency comparison (must fail closed)
1397|# ===========================================================================
1398|
1399|
1400|class TestCrossCurrencyFailsClosed:
1401|    def test_mixed_currencies_in_text(self):
1402|        # parse_money returns the first match only; comparison is caller's job
1403|        result = parse_money("USD 100,000 vs GBP 80,000")
1404|        assert result["ok"] is True
1405|        # First match is USD
1406|        assert result["currency"] == "USD"
1407|
1408|    def test_no_implicit_exchange_rate(self):
1409|        # Verifies we don't silently convert between currencies
1410|        r1 = parse_money("USD 1,000,000")
1411|        r2 = parse_money("AUD 1,000,000")
1412|        assert r1["ok"] and r2["ok"]
1413|        # Same amount string, different currency — cannot compare without a rate
1414|        assert r1["amount"] == r2["amount"]
1415|        assert r1["currency"] != r2["currency"]
1416|

1423|class TestFormatMoney:
1424|    def test_format_usd(self):
1425|        r = parse_money("USD 1,500,000")
1426|        assert r["ok"] is True
1427|        assert format_money(r) == "USD 1,500,000.00"
1428|
1429|    def test_format_aud(self):
1430|        r = parse_money("AUD 250,000")
1431|        assert r["ok"] is True
1432|        assert format_money(r) == "AUD 250,000.00"
1433|
1434|    def test_format_gbp_million(self):
1435|        r = parse_money("£2.5M")
1436|        assert r["ok"] is True
1437|        assert format_money(r) == "GBP 2,500,000.00"
1438|
1439|    def test_format_raises_on_error(self):
1440|        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
1441|            format_money({"ok": False, "reason": "no match"})  # type: ignore[arg-type]

1444|# ===========================================================================
1445|# Round-trip: parse_money → format_money → parse_money
1446|# ===========================================================================
1447|
1448|
1449|class TestRoundTrip:
1450|    def test_usd_roundtrip(self):
1451|        text = "USD 1,500,000"
1452|        r1 = parse_money(text)
1453|        assert r1["ok"] is True
1454|        formatted = format_money(r1)
1455|        r2 = parse_money(formatted)
1456|        assert r2["ok"] is True
1457|        assert Decimal(r2["amount"]) == Decimal(r1["amount"])
1458|        assert r2["currency"] == r1["currency"]
1459|
1460|    def test_aud_roundtrip(self):
1461|        text = "AUD 5,000,000"
1462|        r1 = parse_money(text)
1463|        assert r1["ok"] is True
1464|        formatted = format_money(r1)
1465|        r2 = parse_money(formatted)
1466|        assert r2["ok"] is True
1467|        assert Decimal(r2["amount"]) == Decimal(r1["amount"])
1468|
1469|    def test_gbp_roundtrip(self):
1470|        text = "£750,000"
1471|        r1 = parse_money(text)
1472|        assert r1["ok"] is True
1473|        formatted = format_money(r1)
1474|        r2 = parse_money(formatted)
1475|        assert r2["ok"] is True
1476|        assert Decimal(r2["amount"]) == Decimal(r1["amount"])
1477|
1478|    def test_eur_roundtrip(self):
1479|        text = "EUR 2,500,000"
1480|        r1 = parse_money(text)
1481|        assert r1["ok"] is True
1482|        formatted = format_money(r1)
1483|        r2 = parse_money(formatted)
1484|        assert r2["ok"] is True
1485|        assert Decimal(r2["amount"]) == Decimal(r1["amount"])
1486|
1487|    def test_million_suffix_roundtrip(self):
1488|        text = "$12M"
1489|        r1 = parse_money(text)
1490|        assert r1["ok"] is True
1491|        formatted = format_money(r1)
1492|        r2 = parse_money(formatted)
1493|        assert r2["ok"] is True
1494|        assert Decimal(r2["amount"]) == Decimal("12000000")

1648|# resolve_definition — happy path
1649|# ===========================================================================

1651|
1652|class TestResolveDefinitionHappy:
1653|    def test_exact_match(self):
1654|        result = resolve_definition("Customer", _SAMPLE_REPR)
1655|        assert result["ok"] is True
1656|        assert result["anchor_id"] == "§1.1"
1657|        assert "ACME" in result["definition_body"]
1658|        assert "§3.2" in result["used_in"]
1659|
1660|    def test_case_insensitive_lower(self):
1661|        result = resolve_definition("customer", _SAMPLE_REPR)
1662|        assert result["ok"] is True
1663|        assert result["anchor_id"] == "§1.1"
1664|
1665|    def test_case_insensitive_upper(self):
1666|        result = resolve_definition("ANNUAL FEE", _SAMPLE_REPR)
1667|        assert result["ok"] is True
1668|        assert result["anchor_id"] == "§1.2"
1669|
1670|    def test_mixed_case(self):
1671|        result = resolve_definition("cOnFiDeNtIaL iNfOrMaTiOn", _SAMPLE_REPR)
1672|        assert result["ok"] is True
1673|        assert result["anchor_id"] == "§2.1"
1674|
1675|    def test_leading_trailing_whitespace(self):
1676|        result = resolve_definition("  Customer  ", _SAMPLE_REPR)
1677|        assert result["ok"] is True
1678|        assert result["anchor_id"] == "§1.1"
1679|
1680|    def test_definition_span_returned(self):
1681|        result = resolve_definition("Annual Fee", _SAMPLE_REPR)
1682|        assert result["ok"] is True
1683|        assert result["definition_span"] == [85, 160]
1684|
1685|    def test_used_in_returned(self):
1686|        result = resolve_definition("Confidential Information", _SAMPLE_REPR)
1687|        assert result["ok"] is True
1688|        assert "§8.1" in result["used_in"]
1689|
1690|    def test_empty_used_in_is_list(self):
1691|        # Term with no used_in field in source — must still return a list
1692|        repr_copy = {
1693|            **_SAMPLE_REPR,
1694|            "defined_terms": [
1695|                {
1696|                    "term": "Supplier",
1697|                    "anchor_id": "§1.3",
1698|                    "definition_span": [170, 200],
1699|                    "definition_body": '"Supplier" means Denuto Pty Ltd.',
1700|                }
1701|            ],
1702|        }
1703|        result = resolve_definition("Supplier", repr_copy)
1704|        assert result["ok"] is True
1705|        assert isinstance(result["used_in"], list)
1706|
1707|    def test_partial_match_fallback(self):
1708|        # "Confidential" should fall back to substring match for "Confidential Information"
1709|        result = resolve_definition("Confidential", _SAMPLE_REPR)
1710|        assert result["ok"] is True
1711|        assert result["anchor_id"] == "§2.1"

2041|=== /tmp/hello_agent/tests/symbolic/test_verify.py ===
2042|"""Tests for src.pipeline.symbolic.verify.
2043|
2044|Owner doc: docs/design/bulk-review-neuro-symbolic-reasoning-plan.md §14.3.
2045|
2046|Coverage:
2047|  - Exact, normalised, number-normalised, and fuzzy verification levels
2048|  - OCR artefacts (double spaces, ligatures, character substitutions)
2049|  - Currency formatting (AUD 1,500,000 ↔ digits)
2050|  - Duration paraphrasing (thirty days ↔ 30 days)
2051|  - Edge cases: empty inputs, non-string inputs, Unicode
2052|"""
2053|
2054|from __future__ import annotations
2055|
2056|from src.pipeline.symbolic.verify import FUZZY_THRESHOLD, verify_span
2057|
2058|# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
2059|# Helpers
2060|# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
2061|
2062|
2063|def assert_verified(claim: str, span: str, reason_prefix: str | None = None) -> None:
2064|    result = verify_span(claim, span)
2065|    assert result["ok"] is True, f"Expected ok for {claim!r} in {span!r}: {result}"
2066|    assert result["verified"] is True, f"Expected verified for {claim!r} in {span!r}: {result}"
2067|    if reason_prefix:
2068|        assert result["reason"].startswith(reason_prefix), (
2069|            f"Expected reason starting with {reason_prefix!r}, got {result['reason']!r}"
2070|        )
2071|
2072|
2073|def assert_not_verified(claim: str, span: str) -> None:
2074|    result = verify_span(claim, span)
2075|    assert result["ok"] is True, f"Expected ok=True for {claim!r} in {span!r}: {result}"
2076|    assert result["verified"] is False, f"Expected not verified for {claim!r} in {span!r}: {result}"
2077|
2078|
2079|def assert_error(claim, span) -> None:
2080|    result = verify_span(claim, span)
2081|    assert result["ok"] is False, f"Expected ok=False for claim={claim!r}: {result}"
2082|
2083|
